scope: Pure math only. This proves the plume envelope, the flicker spectrum, the ember distribution and NaN safety. It does NOT prove that anything renders, that a material compiles, or that the effect looks right; those remain visual acceptance items.

checks.name: straight_column_zero_offset_in_any_wind
checks.detail: max |axis offset| over wind 0..2000 cm/s = 0 cm (source claim Avos 5:5)

checks.name: straight_column_within_max_radius
checks.detail: max sampled radius 602.077 cm <= MaxRadiusCm 900

checks.name: envelope_ring_test
checks.detail: 3216 ring samples per side; 0.99R inside and 1.01R outside for both the straight and the physical profile at 900 cm/s wind

checks.name: physical_plume_bends_monotonically
checks.detail: physical offset at 4200 cm in a 900 cm/s wind = 22570.7 cm; monotone in wind and in height

checks.name: height_age_round_trip
checks.detail: max |t(h(t)) - t| below the height cap = 2.13163e-14 s over 0..20 s

checks.name: opacity_monotone_and_bounded
checks.detail: opacity falls monotonically from 1 to 0.147929 and stays within [0.05, 1]

checks.name: ketores_reaches_ceiling_in_a_plausible_time
checks.detail: column reaches the 2925 cm ceiling from the 1004.17 cm altar top in 43.7999 s

checks.name: ketores_column_stops_at_ceiling
checks.detail: column top Z 2924.17 <= ceiling Z 2925

checks.name: ceiling_spread_monotone_and_capped
checks.detail: spread saturates at 1050 / 1050 cm and the layer at 949.036 / 950 cm

checks.name: layer_bottom_stays_between_altar_and_ceiling
checks.detail: layer underside stays within [1004.17, 2925] cm for 200 s

checks.name: ketores_density_zero_outside_the_event
checks.detail: density 0 before begin and 0 after the 148.8 s authored end; bounded in [0,1] throughout

checks.name: ketores_four_phases_all_occur
checks.detail: samples per phase idle/emit/ascend/accumulate/dissipate = 1025/400/476/900/1200

checks.name: puffing_frequency_separates_altar_from_wick
checks.detail: f = 1.5/sqrt(D_m): altar 325 cm -> 0.83205 Hz, lamp 0.6 cm -> 19.3649 Hz

checks.name: flicker_altar_peak_near_puffing_frequency
checks.detail: target 0.83205 Hz, measured peak 0.761719 Hz, centroid 0.780164 Hz

checks.name: flicker_altar_is_band_limited_not_white
checks.detail: energy above 4*f0: filtered 0.00161212 vs white-noise control 0.974377

checks.name: flicker_lamp_peak_near_puffing_frequency
checks.detail: target 19.3649 Hz, measured peak 18.8672 Hz, centroid 18.1202 Hz

checks.name: flicker_lamp_is_band_limited_not_white
checks.detail: energy above 4*f0: filtered 0.00200797 vs white-noise control 0.370872

checks.name: flicker_frame_rate_independent
checks.detail: 3 Hz target: peak at 30 fps 2.68066 Hz, at 240 fps 2.92969 Hz

checks.name: flicker_multiplier_bounded
checks.detail: depth 0.25 maps any flicker value into [0.75, 1.25]

checks.name: ember_lifetimes_bounded
checks.detail: 40000 draws all within [0.25, 8] s

checks.name: ember_lifetime_is_lognormal
checks.detail: sample median 1.59397 s vs requested 1.6 s; sd of log 0.549154 vs requested 0.55

checks.name: ember_lifetime_has_a_tail
checks.detail: 5th percentile 0.639704 s, longest 8 s: most die early, a few ride the column

checks.name: ember_height_monotone
checks.detail: height rises monotonically to 2279.06 cm at 10 s and never exceeds the 4200 cm cap

checks.name: ember_fades_to_black_at_end_of_life
checks.detail: brightness 1 at birth, exactly 0 at and after the lifetime

checks.name: distance_quality_monotone_and_bounded
checks.detail: quality 1 within 3000 cm, 0 beyond 24000 cm, monotone in between

checks.name: card_count_respects_bounds
checks.detail: 0 cards only at quality 0; 4..28 cards otherwise; 28 at full quality

checks.name: no_nan_or_infinity_from_any_entry_point
checks.detail: 5103 evaluations over the cross product of {NaN, +inf, -inf, 0, -0, -1e30, 1e30, -1, 1e-300}; every result finite

checks.name: deterministic_for_a_given_seed
checks.detail: two flickers with seed 1234 agree bit for bit over 5000 steps; ember draws repeat exactly
